findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
5 raw data blocks hold SBR data before the first SBR header of its element, which decoders cannot read; the first at 0x2F.
